items.q: Where do my notes actually go?
items.a: Your notes, audio and search stay on your devices. Only what you hand to an AI leaves: chat, summaries, titles, and cloud transcription if you choose it. Sharing and spaces go through the FlowFlow server.

The app is free for now. You pay your usage directly to OpenAI or Anthropic, or use your ChatGPT subscription for chat. An OpenAI key is still needed for memory. Local Whisper transcription costs nothing.

items.q: Does it work without a connection?
items.a: Capture, transcription (local Whisper model) and reading your notes: yes, airplane mode included. Chat needs the network to reach the model.
No, and whether you work alone or you are hiring, that is not the point. FlowFlow writes, sums up, finds and reminds you what to do. It clears the admin around every conversation.
Yes. A space brings together notes and the people you invite, and your Hermes can read or write there. Creating a space needs the premium plan, set up by appointment.

items.q: Do I have to tell people I'm recording?
items.a: Yes, always, before you start. FlowFlow does not join your calls: it records with your device's microphone.
iPhone (iOS 16+, App Store) and Apple Silicon Mac (DMG signed and notarized by Apple). Some features, such as reminders and widgets, are iPhone only.
Yes, it is all on GitHub under the EUPL. Mainly Rust, with Dioxus for the UI. You can build and install it yourself.
